semantic_fragments.content: Clause 7.2.6 specifies that for non-permanently installed ME EQUIPMENT, supply mains connection markings must appear on the outside of the part containing the SUPPLY MAINS connection and adjacent to the connection point. For PERMANENTLY INSTALLED ME EQUIPMENT, the NOMINAL supply voltage or range is marked inside or outside the ME EQUIPMENT, preferably adjacent to the SUPPLY MAINS connection. Required markings include: rated supply voltage(s) or rated voltage range(s) with hyphen between min and max (V, V-V); multiple rated voltages separated by slash (V/V); nature of supply (phases, type of current); symbols 1-5 of Table D.1 (IEC 60417-5032, 5032-1, 5032-2, 5031, 5033, 2002-10); rated supply frequency or rated frequency range in Hz; Symbol 9 of Table D.1 (IEC 60417-5172, 2003-02) for CLASS II ME EQUIPMENT.

Clause 7.2.7 specifies RATED input marking requirements: input in amps or volt-amps (A, VA); in watts when power factor exceeds 0.9 (A, VA, W); for voltage ranges greater than ±10% of mean, rated input provided for upper and lower limits; when range limits do not differ by more than 10% from mean value, input at mean value of range is marked; marking includes long-time and most relevant momentary volt-ampere ratings, each plainly identified in ACCOMPANYING DOCUMENTS; marked input of ME EQUIPMENT provided with means for connection of supply conductors of other electrical equipment includes rated and marked output of such means.
